description: Don't leave home without a face mask or a place to store it! Rothco's Canvas Face Mask Pouch allows you to carry reusable/disposable facemasks while on the go efficiently. Made from a durable and washable cotton canvas material this 7" x 5" pouch is designed to hold your face mask and other PPE gear. Be sure to also check out our collection of reusable face masks.  *Facemask pictured is not included
